versions.description_html:
Learn how to use Microsoft Forms for surveys, quizzes, and automated workflows. Discover templates, branching, Excel integration, and built-in limits.

Microsoft Forms is the survey and quiz builder you already own. Welcome to the M365 FM podcast, where we explore the people, ideas, and technologies shaping the future of work.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • The Tool You Already Own
  • Building Your First Form
  • When a Survey Becomes a Quiz
  • Branching: The Form That Rewrites Itself
  • Collecting Answers Without the Headache
  • Answers That Land in Excel by Themselves
  • Letting Power Automate Do the Follow-Up
  • The Limits Worth Knowing
  • Where Forms Fits in Your Microsoft World

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Fix Power Apps Forms That Fail to Submit to SharePoint
  • Map Microsoft 365 Users, Groups, Files, and Shares with Graph
  • More Microsoft 365 episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Microsoft 365: the most-listened episodes
